races.name: Coral Chesterfield Cup Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Liberty Lane
runners_data.note: Won over 10f on Soft and has Goodwood course form, but today's 1m2f on Good represents a slight style stretch — racing as an outright front-runner rather than her natural prominent-tracking role (STYLE_FIT 0.93); the unchallenged lead could compensate, but be measured about her true chance.

runners_data.name: Bolster
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who has been absent 53 days and has four of five recent runs on Soft ground; a return to Good at Goodwood is an unproven combination and the 53-day break for a trainer firing at only 1-in-6 over 14 days is a meaningful concern.

runners_data.name: Torito
runners_data.note: Gosden-trained hold-up horse back from a 209-day layoff wearing a hood; his best Good-ground form is respectable (1 win, 3 placed from 6 runs in similar conditions) but a comeback run after seven months makes his readiness uncertain, even if the yard has been in form.

runners_data.name: Midak
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up type who ran just 10 days ago, has Good-ground form, and stays 1m2f well; the quick turnaround for Ian Williams (3 from 24 in 14 days) warrants respect, and Jamie Spencer's patient style suits the waiting game this race shape may require.

runners_data.name: Yabher
runners_data.note: Impressive four-wins-from-five record on Good ground with wins over this course and distance; Haggas sends him out in excellent nick (17-day break, 5-from-28 trainer strike rate) and his hold-up style is genuine — not redistributed — making him one of the more credible late threats.

runners_data.name: Henlein
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose best recent effort was a second over 1m2f on Good, but the bulk of his record is over shorter trips on this course; Kevin Stott has ridden him consistently and the trainer has had no winners in the past 14 days, which tempers confidence.

runners_data.name: Diego El Queso
runners_data.note: Natural prominent racer with strong recent form — won over 1m on Soft, placed twice at Goodwood on Good; Colin Keane's booking is a strong positive, and the horse's ability to slot in second to fourth could prove decisive if Liberty Lane's pace is modest.

runners_data.name: Wave Rider
runners_data.note: Has three placings and a win over this exact course, distance and Good ground from five attempts, making him one of the most proven course-and-distance performers in the field; Oisin Murphy is a significant jockey booking after a 129-day absence, which is the one note of caution.

runners_data.name: Quai De Bethune
runners_data.note: Won over this course and distance on Good ground and is in good recent form, but has been beaten into sixth on his most recent Goodwood start and James Doyle rides a yard that has had no runners in the past 14 days; the class and course form are real, the fitness angle is less clear.

runners_data.name: Night Breeze
runners_data.note: Has won three of his last six and placed in five of his last six over 1m2f at Goodwood specifically, combining course, distance and Good ground as well as any horse in the field; wears a tongue-tie and is trained by Ian Williams who has three runners today, giving Night Breeze a live each-way profile.

runners_data.name: King's Code
runners_data.note: Won over 1m2f at Goodwood on Good ground last time and wears a visor; David Evans has a 4-from-14 14-day strike rate, but the horse's form at shorter trips and on softer ground is patchy — the recent win gives him a legitimate claim and the prominent style suits the anticipated race shape.

runners_data.name: Dhahabi
runners_data.note: An eight-year-old who is a genuine hold-up type; the redistribution tag reflects the congested field rather than his style, and his best form (2 wins, 3 placed from 12 Good-ground runs) is solid — however the 53-day break and Ian Williams running three horses in the same race dilutes focus.

runners_data.name: Rathgar
runners_data.note: Carries strong Goodwood course form (three wins on Good here) and is genuinely a prominent-going type by nature, though the crowded field forces him into a midfield slot on the map; if he can assert early and find his natural rhythm, that form profile is live — the redistribution is circumstantial, not a form concern.

runners_data.name: Noble Horizon
runners_data.note: A natural front-runner who has won twice and placed six times from his last ten on Good at Goodwood; the map pushes him back because of the pack, but Silvestre De Sousa may try to press forward regardless — if he secures a prominent position, this form record is as relevant as anyone's.

runners_data.name: Tony Montana
runners_data.note: Has won twice and placed six times from 15 Good-ground starts, with course experience, but recent form shows finishes of 9-2-6-8 in a mixed pattern; a 74-day absence and the 7lb claimer's removal from a competitive handicap field adds risk.

runners_data.name: Al Aali
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up type compressed to midfield by the redistribution — William Buick's booking for George Scott is the headline angle here; ran just 11 days ago and has a Goodwood win over this trip on Good, but recent form of 8-7-5-5 before a reappearance win suggests his best is hard to predict.

runners_data.name: Parole d'Oro
runners_data.note: Wears a hood and tongue-tie and has been placed six times from 11 Good-ground runs; a natural prominent type pushed back by the crowded field, so his chance depends partly on whether Hector Crouch can manoeuvre him closer than the race shape dictates — the form is consistent but not exceptional.

runners_data.name: Twisting Physics
runners_data.note: A confirmed prominent type who has won twice and placed four times from eight Good-ground starts; the redistribution reflects the queue for front positions rather than any form weakness, and Ashley Lewis's 5lb claim may help offset the weight, though the 29-day break is straightforward.

races.paceDynamic: Liberty Lane is the sole confirmed front-runner in an 18-runner field and, crucially, faces no genuine challenger for the lead — she can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front without being pressed, which on Good ground over 1m2f at Goodwood sets up a strongly contested finish rather than a true test of stamina. Behind her, Diego El Queso, Wave Rider, Quai De Bethune, Night Breeze, King's Code and Tony Montana are all natural prominent types who will compete hard for the handful of tracking positions from stalls to the home turn, creating a bustling, traffic-heavy midfield. This field contains significantly more prominent and hold-up horses than the race shape can accommodate in their natural roles — Rathgar, Noble Horizon, Parole d'Oro and Twisting Physics are genuine prominent types forced into midfield on the map, while Dhahabi and Al Aali are true hold-up horses similarly compressed; those who can assert and secure a forward berth early will have a material advantage. The resulting shape — one unhurried pace-setter, a packed and competitive mid-group, and a compressed bunch of closers — strongly favours horses tracking the leader in second to fifth, close enough to pounce when the tempo lifts in the straight without burning energy in the mid-pack squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead, Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Liberty Lane dictates an unchallenged, even pace and the prominent trackers Night Breeze, Diego El Queso or Wave Rider sit second to fourth throughout.
scenarios.body: Liberty Lane sets a measured gallop that keeps the race well within herself, but those sitting just off her shoulder travel sweetly and have the momentum to sweep past in the Goodwood straight when she inevitably feels the effort late on Good ground; this shape rewards the horses with a clean passage and a prominent pitch. The tracking profile is tailor-made for Night Breeze, who has winning form over this course and distance, and Diego El Queso, who has shown a fondness for sitting just off the pace on Good ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Liberty Lane Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop stays genuinely unhurried throughout and no prominent tracker can find a decisive turn of foot in the straight.
scenarios.body: With a sub-par pace Liberty Lane may simply never come off the bridle, converting her handy position into a wire-to-wire success as the hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up in a short straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent mid-group becomes so congested that it creates a strong enough pace in the final four furlongs to suit horses launching from the rear.
scenarios.body: The traffic and positional jostling burns out several of the prominent types early in the straight, opening a gap for the genuine hold-up horses Yabher and Midak — both of whom carry strong Good-ground form — to power through late. This scenario is partly dependent on Yabher and Midak being genuine closers who can find clear daylight in time, which is credible given both sit outside the redistribution flags.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Scrimmage Produces Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the competition for tracking positions causes interference or pace surges mid-race that unsettle the market leaders, leaving a lightly-regarded runner to capitalise.
scenarios.body: The chaos of 18 runners jostling for limited front-rank positions results in an uneven tempo that scrambles the expected finishing order; Rathgar, who is a genuine prominent type carrying strong Goodwood course form despite the redistribution flag, or Noble Horizon could punch through if they can assert their natural front-running instincts and wrestle a better pitch than the map suggests.

watchPoints.text: Liberty Lane's uncontested lead is the fulcrum of this race — watch whether Clifford Lee allows her to bowl along untroubled or if Diego El Queso or Night Breeze push forward to challenge her early, as any pressure on the front end would fundamentally change who benefits in the straight.

Noble Horizon and Rathgar are both natural prominent horses squeezed into a midfield draw by the race map — watch the early exchanges to see if Silvestre De Sousa or David Probert force their way up, as either finding their true position would make the redistribution irrelevant and their form records highly dangerous.

Wave Rider returns from a 129-day absence for a new trainer engagement with Oisin Murphy; watch the market move at the off — if supported, the course-and-distance form on Good ground is among the strongest in the field, and the layoff may simply be a hold-up before a campaign peak.

Yabher's jockey Tom Marquand will be targeting a late run from well off the pace in what could be a compressed, traffic-heavy straight — watch for any signs of being pocketed on the rail in the final two furlongs, as clear passage is essential to his chance.

Ian Williams saddles three runners (Midak, Night Breeze, Dhahabi) — watch which of the three attracts the sharpest market support in the final hour, as trainer runners in the same race often concentrate stable confidence in one individual.

races.name: Coral Vintage Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Al Hudaiba
runners_data.note: Charlie Appleby's unbeaten filly (three wins, all at Goodwood 7f on good) carries the most convincing course-and-distance profile in the field; William Buick rides with 132lbs including hood, and her prominent style is perfectly suited to tracking a contested pace before asserting in the final furlong.

runners_data.name: Dr Rascal
runners_data.note: Two from two at Goodwood 7f on good going, Oliver Cole's colt has thrived on this exact track-trip-going combination, but stepping up markedly in class against OR 120-rated rivals and facing a direct front-running rival in Haffner makes a third straight front-running victory a tall order at 17 days rest.

runners_data.name: Haffner
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore takes the mount on Aidan O'Brien's highest-rated runner in the field at OR 120; a winner over course and distance last time, Haffner's confirmed front-running style means it will bid to own the rail from the off, and its class edge is the key variable that separates it from the Dr Rascal lead-battle.

runners_data.name: Pikachu
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's colt arrives on the back of mixed form (2-5-3 last three) and, while a genuine prominent racer by nature, the surplus of pace in this field means it is unlikely to secure that position — mapped to midfield accordingly, and that STYLE_FIT friction tempers confidence in its participation in the finish.

runners_data.name: Ruler's Control
runners_data.note: Joseph O'Brien's lightly-raced colt (only one run on good going) steps up sharply in trip from its 5f Healy Racing win, but a prominent style and the services of James Doyle give it the tactical tools to slot in behind the front-running battle at 7f; the 41-day absence and lack of Goodwood form are the main queries.

runners_data.name: Undiscovered
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's filly has won her last two starts (7f Goodwood good, 6f soft) and arrives in excellent form, but her natural prominent-racing tendency has been pushed to the rear of the map because the field is overloaded with pace-committed types — her true racing position will be closer than the map suggests, though the redistribution means she cannot be relied upon to deliver a genuine hold-up challenge.

races.paceDynamic: Haffner and Dr Rascal are both confirmed front-runners and will contest the lead from the gates, creating a genuinely competitive early gallop over Goodwood's 7f on good ground. Ryan Moore on Haffner will look to assert control at a strong but manageable tempo, while Kaiya Fraser on Dr Rascal will press that lead throughout, meaning neither is likely to get a soft lead. Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control, both prominent racers, will sit just off the speed and are ideally placed to capitalise if the dual lead-battle burns the front two out in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours prominent-to-midfield horses with a sustained galloping style and a clean turn of foot in the final 2f — horses that can travel within a length of the pace without being embroiled in the front-running battle are the primary beneficiaries. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than the race can accommodate at the head of affairs: Haffner and Dr Rascal are most likely to secure their natural position, with Pikachu unlikely to get the prominent pitch it prefers and mapped to midfield as a result.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Lead, Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Haffner and Dr Rascal push each other along at a strong honest gallop, setting it up for a horse travelling just off the pace.
scenarios.body: The front two burn each other up through the first 4f, leaving the race wide open for Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control to slide past in the closing stages on fresh legs. William Buick's front-foot hold on Al Hudaiba and James Doyle's clean positional judgment on Ruler's Control both suit this shape perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Haffner Controls, Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Ryan Moore settles Haffner into a dominant rhythm and Dr Rascal fails to match him stride-for-stride early.
scenarios.body: Moore dictates a fair but not breakneck gallop, Haffner relaxes beautifully, and the winning move comes when Moore asks at the 2f pole with no rival able to bridge the gap. This scenario rewards Haffner's class advantage at OR 120 and its confirmed Goodwood form, with Al Hudaiba the only horse likely to get close.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Midfield Sweep
scenarios.trigger: If the front-running duel is more attritional than anticipated and a late charger finds an uncontested run up the centre.
scenarios.body: Pikachu, though racing out of its preferred position, possesses enough raw ability to motor through beaten horses if the race implodes, and Undiscovered — similarly pushed out of its natural prominent role — could get involved from the back. The STYLE_FIT discounts on both horses limit how confidently this shape can be backed, but it remains a live outsider threat if the pace genuinely collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dr Rascal Leads Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dr Rascal breaks quickest, establishes a clear lead, and Haffner fails to match early speed, allowing a controlled front-running display.
scenarios.body: With OR 95 Dr Rascal would be a considerable upset but the horse has won both career starts at Goodwood and Fraser could steal a march if Haffner is slow away. This is a low-probability shape because Haffner's class at OR 120 and Moore's experience make it unlikely Dr Rascal goes unchallenged long enough to dictate.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Dr Rascal or Haffner establishes early dominance — if Moore lets Haffner coast clear unchallenged in the first 2f, the race shape shifts entirely from Scenario A to Scenario B and the prominent horses lose their primary weapon.

Ruler's Control is stepping up from 5f to 7f for the first time and has only one run on good going — if James Doyle cannot get it to settle prominently in the first half, its stamina over the trip becomes a genuine concern in the closing stages.

Pikachu's inability to secure its preferred prominent position in this field is a structural disadvantage — watch in the first furlong whether David Egan even attempts to push forward, as any early traffic problem will leave it chasing a rapidly vanishing pace.

Al Hudaiba carries 132lbs with hood (highest weight in the race) — monitor whether William Buick rides her more conservatively than her front-foot Goodwood style suggests, as the extra weight burden on good ground at 7f could influence how aggressively he deploys her early.

The going is confirmed Good throughout the card at Goodwood — no deterioration between earlier races and this 2:25 slot, so no ground-related advantage or disadvantage should accrue to any runner whose form is specifically optimised for softer or firmer conditions.

races.name: Hkjc World Pool Lennox Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Holguin
runners_data.note: Six-year-old with strong course form at Goodwood including a recent third here over 7f; naturally wants to race prominently and is likely to push forward to reclaim that position despite being mapped to midfield due to the overcrowded prominent ranks — James Doyle's handling of the early stages will be decisive.|

runners_data.name: Lake Forest
runners_data.note: The sole confirmed front-runner, William Haggas's five-year-old has excellent course form (1st here over 7f in similar going) and Cieren Fallon can dictate entirely on his own terms from an OR of 119; 38 days since last run is not a concern for a confirmed front-runner who benefits from a solo lead.|

runners_data.name: Marvelman
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's four-year-old is a genuine prominent racer who has form on Good and Soft at seven furlongs; PJ McDonald holds the natural position if the pace group stays manageable, and this horse's profile — winning at this trip on Good — makes it a straight forward fit for the dominant scenario.|

runners_data.name: Poet Master
runners_data.note: Consistent performer with multiple seconds and thirds over 7f on Good and Soft; his natural desire to race prominently is constrained here by the sheer number of similar types, and Clifford Lee may find the horse forced to work harder than ideal to find his rhythm in a messy early-stages scenario.|

runners_data.name: Qirat
runners_data.note: Won over this exact course and distance on Good last time, giving Ralph Beckett's five-year-old strong situational claims; Colin Keane is likely to push forward from a natural prominent style despite being shown in midfield here — tongue tie fitted and recent course-winning form make this one of the most interesting runners regardless of scenario.|

runners_data.name: Rogue Diplomat
runners_data.note: James Owen's four-year-old has course-winning form on Good (1st over 1m at Goodwood) and has placed at 7f; a natural prominent type squeezed into midfield by the field's composition, Harry Davies will need a clear run from what may be a congested early middle-order.|

runners_data.name: Witness Stand
runners_data.note: Trainer combination of Dr Newland & Insole applies tongue tie and a pacemaker-style profile, but recent form is patchy (finished 6th, 8th, 15th in last three Goodwood starts); prominent in style but struggling to find the required level of form, Kieran Shoemark faces a stiff task if the race is truly competitive.|

runners_data.name: Lord Britain
runners_data.note: The only genuine hold-up runner in the field and the sole three-year-old, carrying 7lbs less than his rivals at 125lbs; Benoit de la Sayette will need Lake Forest to post a genuinely strong tempo to set up a late run, and the lack of course form on Good (0W0P from three Goodwood starts) tempers expectations significantly.|

races.paceDynamic: Lake Forest is the one confirmed front-runner in this eight-runner field and, with no genuine rival likely to force the pace from beside him, Cieren Fallon can dictate terms at a sustainable gallop over Goodwood's seven furlongs on Good ground. The field is heavily loaded with prominent types — Holguin, Qirat, Poet Master and Rogue Diplomat all want to race close to the pace but cannot all occupy that position, meaning several will be shuffled wider or held marginally off the speed against their natural inclinations. With a single, unchallenged pace-setter controlling a steady-to-moderate tempo, this race shape classically suits those who can race prominently in the slipstream of Lake Forest and produce a sustained finish from two furlongs out — pure hold-up horses relying on a true, punishing gallop to collapse the leaders are at a structural disadvantage. This field holds more genuine prominent types than can all secure their preferred position, and of those redistributed to midfield on the map, Qirat and Holguin are most likely to push forward and reclaim ground near the pace, with Poet Master and Rogue Diplomat the more likely to be inconvenienced.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lake Forest Dictates Solo
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Forest gets a clean break and settles into an uncontested lead at a controlled tempo with no rival willing to commit alongside him.
scenarios.body: Lake Forest sets fractions entirely on his own terms, the field bunches behind him, and those able to track him at close range into the straight are best placed to pounce; a moderate gallop means the race is decided by finishing kick from the front two or three rather than by stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Posse Quickens
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent types press Lake Forest hard enough to create a more genuinely-run race that tests the leaders' finishing reserves.
scenarios.body: The pace is genuine from the start as Holguin, Qirat or Marvelman refuse to settle deep and apply early pressure on Lake Forest, lifting the tempo and stringing the field out; those with the class to sustain a strong gallop over seven furlongs on Good ground come to the fore in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the straight and Lord Britain is produced with a late run to exploit a field that has burned out.
scenarios.body: Lord Britain is the only true hold-up runner in the race and would need the leaders to tie themselves in knots early before he can deliver his challenge from off the pace; this scenario is structurally unlikely given the limited genuine front-running pace and the preference of most rivals to race prominently rather than force a true test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race produces an unusually messy shape — crowding, traffic and positional disputes among the redistributed prominent types — that creates a clear passage for a lower-rated runner.
scenarios.body: Rogue Diplomat or Witness Stand, finding themselves in a less congested pocket if the midfield scramble causes interference, could exploit the chaos with a well-timed run; this scenario hinges entirely on the tactical disorder of the redistributed pack rather than any class advantage.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Qirat and Holguin both attempt to push forward from their displaced positions in the early stages — if both commit, they could create unexpected pressure on Lake Forest that transforms the tempo and opens the door for Marvelman to sit the perfect trip behind a genuine pace.

Lake Forest's price will be closely watched at the off; if he drifts significantly, it may signal Haggas camp concern about the 38-day absence or the step back to 7f, which would materially change the pace scenario if he is ridden conservatively rather than from the front.

Lord Britain's 7lb weight advantage as a three-year-old is a latent danger in a race that may not produce a true pace — monitor whether Benoit de la Sayette opts to track closer than expected rather than sit last if he senses the gallop will be insufficient for a hold-up run.

Witness Stand wears a tongue tie (tp) and has beaten only two rivals in its last three Goodwood starts over this trip — if this runner pushes forward aggressively on a good surface it could briefly disrupt the shape before falling away, creating a brief bunching event behind Lake Forest.

Poet Master's rider Clifford Lee has limited Goodwood experience at this level — watch whether the horse is caught wide early as the prominent pack jostles for position, which would compound the energy cost of racing out of its ideal slot.

races.name: Al Shaqab Goodwood Cup Stakes (Group 1)

runners_data.name: Amiloc
runners_data.note: Finished 1st at 12f on similar Goodwood Good ground and has strong Goodwood form (3W4P on sim-going), but his natural prominent style is squeezed out here with so many rivals wanting the same position, meaning he will likely race off his ideal pace map.

runners_data.name: French Master
runners_data.note: Boasts a Goodwood Gold Cup run (2/22f) and handles this trip, but five prominent-type rivals means he cannot race where he wants; headgear (p) noted and his sim-going record (9/11) is solid, though racing in midfield blunts his effectiveness.

runners_data.name: Illinois
runners_data.note: Won the Gold Cup at this course (1/22f) so has the key distance and track form, and is fresh off a nine-day turnaround; his true prominent style is displaced into midfield by race shape, and he must work hard to reclaim ground his class suggests he should not need to give away.

runners_data.name: Lazy Griff
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's four-year-old has five consecutive placed or winning efforts at 12-16f on Good Goodwood ground (8/10 sim-going) and arrives in fine form (223-31); Oisin Murphy takes the ride, but like the other prominent types, being shuffled back will test how well he travels off a potentially moderate pace.

runners_data.name: Rahiebb
runners_data.note: Won his last race (1/14f/GOO) and has course form at this trip (8/20f/GOO when 8th at the Cup), making him a natural to press Trawlerman; Roger Varian's 4yo is one of the prominent types most likely to actually secure a forward position given his recent confidence.

runners_data.name: Scandinavia
runners_data.note: Unbeaten in five starts (11-111) including a Goodwood Cup win at this exact trip (1/20f/GOO), and Ryan Moore's presence alongside an exceptional sim-going record (10/11, 6W8P) makes her the standout prominent type capable of locking onto Trawlerman and posing the most credible threat.

runners_data.name: Trawlerman
runners_data.note: The confirmed front-runner, eight-year-old with four Goodwood wins and a 6W9P sim-going record; William Buick will set an unhurried, professional gallop and his experience at this track and trip makes him uniquely well-placed to dictate the shape of this race.

runners_data.name: Miss Alpilles
runners_data.note: The only genuine hold-up horse (style=H) in the field, with two Goodwood wins including at 16f, and Kieran Shoemark takes the ride; she needs Trawlerman to maintain a strong enough gallop for long enough for her closing run to count, which in an uncontested solo lead scenario may not materialise.

races.paceDynamic: Trawlerman is the sole confirmed front-runner in this field and, with William Buick in the saddle, will dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop over the two-mile Goodwood trip on Good ground — there is no rival likely to challenge him for the lead, so he faces minimal pressure in establishing his rhythm. Scandinavia, Rahiebb, Lazy Griff, Illinois, Amiloc and French Master all want to race prominently but the race shape can only accommodate one or two horses at the front, meaning most of that group will be shuffled into an unnatural midfield position and will need to produce a late run foreign to their true style. Miss Alpilles is the lone genuine hold-up horse and will track the pace from the rear, relying on a strong gallop to be maintained long enough to close. The field holds more prominent-type runners than can possibly secure their preferred position, with Scandinavia — given Ryan Moore, unbeaten form and the highest recent winning profile — and Rahiebb most likely to actually sit close to Trawlerman; the displaced prominent types in midfield create a complicated traffic scenario late. This race shape strongly favours a well-judged front-running or close-tracking performance, with the winner most likely to come from the two horses who successfully latch onto Trawlerman's heels rather than from the congested midfield mass.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Trawlerman Controls, Rivals Chase
scenarios.trigger: If Trawlerman leads at a fair but unforced pace and no rival disrupts his rhythm, reducing the race to a stamina-test from the home turn.
scenarios.body: Buick pings Trawlerman to the front and settles him on a controlled tempo, with Scandinavia or Rahiebb the only rivals willing to sit close; the two-mile trip on Good ground becomes a thorough examination of staying class in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Scandinavia Stalks and Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Ryan Moore tracks Trawlerman at close quarters throughout and delivers Scandinavia's challenge smoothly turning for home.
scenarios.body: Scandinavia's unbeaten Group record and exceptional sim-going profile (10/11) make her ideally suited to sitting second and picking off a tiring leader; Moore's positional sense at Goodwood is a significant asset over this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to stretch the field significantly and those displaced into midfield run below par, allowing Miss Alpilles to close ground off a true gallop.
scenarios.body: Miss Alpilles showed she can win over this trip and course when conditions suit (1/16f/GOO) and a genuine pace scenario would play to her staying finish; however this scenario hinges on a faster-than-expected tempo that Trawlerman alone is unlikely to force.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Scrimmage
scenarios.trigger: If jostling among the multiple prominent types creates interference early, disrupting Trawlerman's control and creating a messy pace scenario.
scenarios.body: Bunching among Amiloc, French Master, Illinois and Lazy Griff — all racing out of their preferred position — could lead to an uneven gallop, but the redistribution of these horses makes genuine race disruption unlikely given their natural tendency to be covered up.

watchPoints.text: Scandinavia and Trawlerman — if Ryan Moore positions Scandinavia directly behind Buick at the top of the straight, those two are likely to dominate and the rest struggle to land a blow.

Amiloc, Illinois, Lazy Griff and French Master — four prominent types all trying to find the same ground in the first half-mile; watch for early crowding or jostling between the 2m start and the first bend as they sort out positions.

Miss Alpilles — watch whether Kieran Shoemark elects to track closer than her natural hold-up style suggests, given the moderate pace Trawlerman is likely to set; if she gets detached early she will need a sprint the distance may not permit.

Rahiebb — Ray Dawson sits on a horse fresh off a win and likely to push forward; if he successfully tracks Trawlerman he becomes the dark horse in the leading duo battle, but his Goodwood Cup record (8th at 20f last year) is worth noting at the full trip.

Going reports confirm Good across all distances at Goodwood today — no softening or patches to favour any specific style — meaning class and tactical position at the top of the straight will be the decisive factors.

races.name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Jasour
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer at Goodwood over 5-6f on Good ground, sim-going record solid at 13/15, but all recent form is over 6f and the drop to 5f on a flat track is worth monitoring; P J McDonald a positive booking for a horse that needs a clear run.

runners_data.name: Run Boy Run
runners_data.note: Sole confirmed front-runner in the race, set to take the field along at a sustainable clip; 1W2P at Goodwood on Good, but carries top weight for a 7lb claimer and faces a wide, competitive field that could make it difficult to dictate fully; racing arguably out of its deepest prominent role gives it the best possible pitch.

runners_data.name: Lexington Blitz
runners_data.note: Three wins from five over 5f on Good at Goodwood is a compelling course-and-distance profile, and Robert Cowell's runner comes into this fresh (52 days) having won last time at this track; prominent style suits the scenario if it avoids the early scrimmage.

runners_data.name: Candy
runners_data.note: Won over 6f on Soft and has course exposure at Goodwood, but recent form figures of 0416-0 are modest and a prominent style in a 24-runner sprint means it must find a smooth passage; Jack Callan 3lb claim softens the weight slightly.

runners_data.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with a decent sim-going record, but recent form (30960) suggests she has gone off the boil; 52 days off track alongside stablemate Lexington Blitz, and her Goodwood 5f record on similar going shows previous wins at the course.

runners_data.name: Toca Madera
runners_data.note: Exceptional course and trip specialist with 15/15 sim-going record and a previous 5f Goodwood win; prominent style is well-suited if it secures a clean pitch, and Daniel Tudhope is an astute booking in a big field; 0 from last 6 tempers confidence.

runners_data.name: Adrestia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong Goodwood course form (all five recent runs here on Good or similar), but form has regressed from a 2nd in 2024 to an 11th most recently; Oisin Murphy is a strong positive, and she needs to reverse that recent downward trend.

runners_data.name: Germanic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 185 days off, wins on Fibresand and AW rather than Good turf, and sim-going record is a thin 3/15 — the lack of turf Good-ground evidence is a significant concern in a race where course specialists dominate.

runners_data.name: Regal Envoy
runners_data.note: Veteran 7-year-old with three 5f Goodwood wins and an 11/15 sim-going record; prominent style suits if the race sets up cleanly, and Taylor Fisher's 3lb claim helps on a rising OR; consistent place record (3W6P) marks him as a live contender.

runners_data.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners_data.note: Won over 5f on Good at Goodwood and on Soft elsewhere, and has placed here on multiple occasions; prominent style and a 10/15 sim-going record give her a solid profile, though recent form (36-141) includes a promising latest win at Catterick.

runners_data.name: The Man
runners_data.note: Six runs without a win in recent form (8-6660) and prominent style in a 24-runner sprint means it must avoid trouble throughout; course-and-going form is modest and a 3lb claim from David Egan does not fully offset the lack of recent positive form.

runners_data.name: Twilight Calls
runners_data.note: One of the most compelling profiles in the race — 2W3P at Goodwood over 5f on Good, including two recent wins, and a strong hold-up style that suits a contested prominent battle ahead; Saffie Osborne rides, and headgear marked as 'v' adds a consistency angle.

runners_data.name: Desert Cop
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with a perfect 15/15 sim-going record and proven Goodwood 6f form (1W4P); dropping from 6f to 5f is worth noting, but Benoit de la Sayette rides for the in-form George Baker yard (T14:3/7) which is a significant positive pointer.

runners_data.name: Exclamation
runners_data.note: Three-year-old hold-up type with 9/14 sim-going and a previous 5f Goodwood win; form has been mixed (901902) but that recent 2nd at Goodwood is rock-solid evidence for this course and trip; the yard (T14:3/22) is in decent form.

runners_data.name: Glamorous Breeze
runners_data.note: Eight-year-old with three 5f wins including at Goodwood, genuinely a prominent horse pushed into a midfield map position by the crowded field — her natural style is to race up with the pace, and from a drawn-back pitch her ability to reproduce peak form is reduced.

runners_data.name: Rapper's Delight
runners_data.note: Multiple placed efforts at Goodwood over 5f on Good ground (two 2nds here), and a true prominent racer who finds himself mapped to midfield purely due to field congestion; style-fit score of 0.90 reflects the real cost of racing from an unnatural position in this scenario.

runners_data.name: Ziggy's Triton
runners_data.note: Previous 5f Goodwood winner with a prominent style, but recent form (107071) is inconsistent and sim-going record is a modest 5/15 compared to rivals with deeper Goodwood turf profiles; Tom Marquand is a strong jockey booking that keeps it interesting.

runners_data.name: Tatterstall
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who finished 5th, 2nd and 3rd in his last three starts, all at Goodwood over 5f on Good ground — a 12/15 sim-going record and 3W6P career tally make him a serious player if the closers get their run.

runners_data.name: Seven Questions
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with a prior 5f Goodwood win on Good ground and 9/15 sim-going; recent form has faded (364170) and Jamie Spencer will look to produce a late run, but the form needs to improve on most recent outings to threaten here.

runners_data.name: Dyonisos
runners_data.note: Won over 5f at Goodwood on Good ground and has multiple placed efforts here, making him a genuine course performer — however, a true prominent racer by style, he is mapped to midfield by congestion, and his ability to win from that position is meaningfully discounted by the redistribution.

runners_data.name: Vintage Clarets
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old hold-up type who has placed twice on Soft but whose Goodwood Good-ground record is thinner (7/15 sim-going); mapped to midfield from a true rear position due to redistribution, so the note of caution around reproducing best from an unnatural pitch applies here too.

runners_data.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners_data.note: Multiple placed efforts at Goodwood over 5f on Good ground (2W4P in the hist), but a genuine prominent runner pushed back into midfield by the sheer number of forward types — Paul Midgley's runner may struggle to deliver from a position that doesn't suit its running style.

runners_data.name: Wheels Of Fire
runners_data.note: Richard Hannon's 4-year-old returns after 57 days off; a true hold-up horse mapped to midfield by redistribution, and while there is a previous 5f win on Soft and a 10/15 sim-going record, the combination of a long absence and unnatural map position tempers expectations significantly.

races.paceDynamic: Run Boy Run is the sole confirmed front-runner in a 24-runner field and, with only light pressure anticipated, is expected to bowl along at a sustainable gallop from the outset on Good ground at Goodwood's straight 5f. The crowded prominent berths mean Lexington Blitz, Toca Madera, Adrestia, Regal Envoy and Naana's Sparkle will all compete hard for the best early positions behind the leader, creating a genuine mid-race fight for supremacy that could compromise several of them. Hold-up horses Twilight Calls, Desert Cop, Jasour and Seven Questions will settle towards the rear and look to deliver late runs down the stands-side rail or centre, and on Good ground at Goodwood that finishing burst is a legitimate weapon over 5f. The field holds significantly more prominent/front-running types than can all settle in their preferred position — Rapper's Delight, Glamorous Breeze, Dyonisos and Spring Is Sprung are true front-prominent horses who will be squeezed back, and in a race this congested it is Run Boy Run, Lexington Blitz and Toca Madera most likely to actually secure early positions. The race shape — a lone, unhurried leader with a scrappy battle immediately behind — sets up favourably for well-placed hold-up horses who can avoid traffic and finish strongly, while any true prominent runner who does pinch a clean early pitch on Good ground also remains dangerous.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Run Boy Run sets a measured pace and the prominent scrimmage burns off its rivals, leaving the hold-up brigade with a clear late run.
scenarios.body: Run Boy Run's uncontested lead creates a falsely even gallop for the first two furlongs, but the fight for prominent ground among Toca Madera, Adrestia, Regal Envoy and Lexington Blitz means those horses have already spent energy by halfway, opening a clear lane for the closers in the final furlong. Twilight Calls and Desert Cop, both proven Goodwood 5f hold-up types on Good ground, are the primary beneficiaries, while Jasour and Tatterstall also carry strong profiles for this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early scrimmage for prominent positions resolves quickly and two or three horses settle into a clean pitch just off Run Boy Run without burning too much petrol.
scenarios.body: With the field strung across Goodwood's wide 5f straight, a horse that slots into second or third without being pressured into the lead can travel sweetly and hit the line hardest, particularly on Good ground that rewards a balanced, smooth-travelling prominent type. Lexington Blitz has outstanding 5f Goodwood form and prominent credentials, while Toca Madera is an expert at this course and trip and both are best-placed to seize this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Run Boy Run is allowed to bowl along completely unchallenged and the prominent scrimmage behind locks up its nearest rivals, allowing the leader to control tempo and quicken clear.
scenarios.body: With a 7lb claim for Toby Moore keeping the weight down and a good recent record at Goodwood, Run Boy Run could simply steal enough of a break that no closer or prominently-placed rival can reel it in over the final furlong on the straight Good ground. This scenario requires the hold-up brigade to encounter traffic and the prominent pack to fail to close the gap, which is plausible in a 24-runner straight sprint.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistributed Types Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the displaced prominent horses — Rapper's Delight, Glamorous Breeze or Dyonisos — manage to find an unexpected clear run from their unnatural midfield position and arrive with a sustained late challenge.
scenarios.body: This is the lowest-probability shape because all three horses are racing out of their preferred prominent role, and their style-fit penalties reflect the genuine likelihood they cannot reproduce their best from further back. However, if the race becomes rough and chaotic early, one of these horses ridden quietly in midfield could emerge as an unexpected finisher, with Dyonisos — who has Goodwood 5f form on Good ground — the most plausible of the three.

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)
Bolney English Wine Fillies' Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Betty Clover
runners_data.note: Eve Johnson Houghton hold-up specialist with two prior runs at this course and trip; sim-going record of 0 wins but consistent placings suggest she stays the mile well on Good, though 41 days off and a recent string of defeats at Goodwood (23rd last time) tempers expectations.

runners_data.name: Nanino Niyati
runners_data.note: Owen Burrows filly dropping back from 10f where she has been finishing strongly; 2 wins from 7 runs on similar going is a solid strike rate, and the step back to a mile looks tailor-made — Callum Rodriguez should be able to produce her late and challenge off what promises to be a steady tempo.

runners_data.name: Just Call Me Angel
runners_data.note: Ed Dunlop's 3yo has three wins in five starts on Good going and is proven over this mile at Goodwood; Robert Havlin will want to sit prominently but the crowded middle-order may require patience — her class and course form still make her a pivotal figure regardless of where she ends up in the pack.

runners_data.name: Rumba Numba
runners_data.note: Roger Varian's consistent prominent racer has won twice at Goodwood's mile and holds solid form on similar going; Jack Mitchell will be keen to sit handy but the prominent cluster is congested, and her most recent run — 5th at Goodwood — suggests she may find one or two too good at the finish.

runners_data.name: Song N Dance
runners_data.note: S Woods filly who races prominently and has won on this going and trip; back-to-back wins this season give her confidence, though David Egan faces a tactical puzzle with six others vying for the same prominent berth and her highest recent form has come at slightly shorter trips.

runners_data.name: Electrifarhh
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's 4yo wears a hood and races from the rear; her last three runs on Good going have been moderate (6th, 2nd, 1st at Goodwood), and 57 days off is worth noting — she is capable of a big run but needs the pace to be honest enough to bring hold-up tactics into play.

runners_data.name: Annastarzy
runners_data.note: Richard Hannon's 3yo is in superb form with three wins from her last three starts, all on Good going at Goodwood over this trip; Joe Leavy has strong course form and Annastarzy's ability to sit prominently and quicken is ideally suited to this race shape — the dominant trainer in form has to be respected here.

runners_data.name: Vixey
runners_data.note: Simon West's 6yo is by nature a prominent racer but the density of that group means she is likely to find herself further back than ideal; three course wins on similar going over this distance show she has the profile, but racing out of her natural position is a genuine concern that tempers her chance.

runners_data.name: Star Mirage
runners_data.note: Hamad Al Jehani's 3yo returns from a 221-day absence, which is a significant fitness concern; she showed promise with two placed efforts over 7f on Good going and steps up to a mile for the first time — Jamie Spencer's experience helps but the layoff and trip rise are both unknowns.

runners_data.name: Si Grass
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's 3yo won over this trip at Sandown and placed over 7f on Soft, but faces a 167-day break — the longest layoff in the field — and drops into a competitive handicap; Silvestre De Sousa's booking suggests connections are confident she returns fresh, but the absence is an obvious risk.

runners_data.name: Crazee Icon
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's 3yo is a genuine two-time winner over this course and trip, both on similar going, and has strong recent form; although her natural front-running/prominent style means she is likely crowded out of her ideal position in this field, her class and form figures mean she cannot be dismissed if she threads through from midfield.

runners_data.name: Atlantis Blue
runners_data.note: George Baker's 7yo hold-up specialist has been placing consistently at Sandown on All-Weather but her Goodwood turf record on similar going is modest; Luke Morris will look for a late run but a sim-going strike rate of 2W3P across 15 runs suggests she finds the competition here at the top end of what she can achieve.

runners_data.name: Wid
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's 3yo is the field's sole confirmed front-runner and has won and been placed over this course and trip on Good going; Edward Greatrex should find the early lead uncontested, giving her every chance to control the race — her chance depends on whether the moderate pace protects her stamina to the line.

runners_data.name: Proposal
runners_data.note: William Haggas's 3yo is a winner over 7f at Goodwood and a natural prominent racer who will be pushed into a midfield role by the sheer volume of pace in this field; 66 days off is worth noting alongside the step up to a mile, and Saffie Osborne will need a clear passage to make her natural positional aggression count.

runners_data.name: Perdy In Paris
runners_data.note: George Baker's 3yo has placed on her last two starts over 7f at Sandown on Standard going and steps up in trip for the first time; she is inclined to race prominently but given the prominence cluster she is most likely to track midfield — the headgear flag (tongue-tie) and trip extension are both unknowns on this evidence.

races.paceDynamic: Wid is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, Edward Greatrex should be able to dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on this flat Goodwood mile. Behind her, there is significant congestion for the prominent positions — Just Call Me Angel, Rumba Numba, Song N Dance, Annastarzy, and Star Mirage all want to race prominently, creating pressure 2-3 furlongs out as the field compresses turning for home. The field holds more prominent types than can all secure their natural position: Crazee Icon, Vixey, Proposal, and Perdy In Paris are genuine prominent racers by style but are most likely to be shuffled into midfield, with Annastarzy and Just Call Me Angel best placed to actually hold prominent ground given their recent course form and superior handlers. With a steady early pace almost certain and a bunched mid-race shape, the race sets up as a test of late acceleration — hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick are best positioned, though prominent types in genuine positions directly behind the leader can also travel sweetly and strike if the gallop stays honest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wid Controls, Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Wid sets a steady, uncontested tempo and the field strings out late.
scenarios.body: Wid's unchallenged lead means fractions are moderate, but the bunching of prominent runners 2-3f out creates interference, leaving genuine hold-up horses with clear runs from off the pace to finish powerfully. Nanino Niyati and Betty Clover, both proven on Good going at Goodwood, profile as natural beneficiaries of a steadily-run race with a late surge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Jam Favours Handy Types
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent cluster causes mid-race congestion that disrupts hold-up runners.
scenarios.body: If six prominent runners compete for position 2-3f out, the resultant shuffling and checking damages late finishers most, while the cleanest travellers — those sitting just behind Wid in the slipstream — emerge with a decisive advantage. Just Call Me Angel and Annastarzy both have the course form and positional awareness to capitalise from a clear berth in second or third.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wid Front-Runs Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so modest that Wid builds an unassailable lead turning for home.
scenarios.body: A gentle early gallop could allow Wid to coast into a daylight advantage rounding the bend, leaving the mid-pack with too much ground to close on good ground where sustained speed matters. Wid's recent Goodwood form — a win and second on this exact course and going — makes this a genuine possibility if rivals are slow to challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistributed Types Gain Ground
scenarios.trigger: If prominent horses shuffled back — Crazee Icon, Proposal, or Vixey — find unexpected gaps and recover to chase the frame.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires the congestion to resolve earlier than expected, giving natural prominent types pushed into midfield the chance to thread through and reclaim ground near the pace. Crazee Icon's recent back-to-back wins give it the profile to benefit if it secures a clear passage, though its style fit in a forced midfield role represents a meaningful discount on its chances.

watchPoints.text: Prominent congestion between Just Call Me Angel, Rumba Numba, Song N Dance, Annastarzy, and Star Mirage creates a high-risk 2-3f-out cluster — watch for checks, bumping, and blocked runs that could cost several of these horses a realistic chance.

Wid leads uncontested but Edward Greatrex will need to manage his fractions carefully — if the gallop is too slow it sets up a sprint finish that could expose Wid's stamina; if he quickens too soon the hold-up horses may not have time to close.

Star Mirage (221 days off) and Si Grass (167 days off) are the two longest-absent runners in the field — both have question marks over fitness that could see them beaten on conditioning alone if they fail to handle the return promptly.

Crazee Icon, Vixey, Proposal, and Perdy In Paris are all being asked to race further back than their natural style dictates — monitor them for signs of being checked or trapped on the rail in the straight where a clear run from that position is hardest to find.

Annastarzy arrives in career-best form with three straight wins at this course and trip on identical going — watch her move through the gears around 2f out as the most likely horse to kick off the final bend and stretch the field.

races.name: World Pool Bet With The Tote EBF Fillies' Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Cinque Verde
runners_data.note: The confirmed sole pace-setter here, likely to lead unchallenged and set a modest tempo; her Goodwood form is solid (won here over 6f) but her STYLE_FIT tag reflects she rarely races as the pure lone leader she will be today, and 66 days off may have sharpened or blunted her edge — Tony Carroll sends her in form (5/42 past 14 days).

runners_data.name: Hold A Dream
runners_data.note: Clive Cox 4yo with strong Goodwood course form including a win at the track; wants a prominent position and arrives fresh enough at 18 days since last run, though her last two outings here (10th and 7th) suggest she is not always firing at her best on this track.

runners_data.name: Stormy Impact
runners_data.note: Has prominent-race experience and placed form at Goodwood over 6f, but the 5f records in similar going are mixed; Warren Fentiman (3) takes over from a more experienced partner, which is a mild concern in a 21-runner sprint where tactical decisions matter early.

runners_data.name: Cindy Lou Who
runners_data.note: Carroll's second runner here, a natural front-lick filly whose recent form string (3-2995) tells of a horse on a downward curve after an early-season peak; the prominent position is natural but she needs career-best form to win from OR 90.

runners_data.name: Gold Digger
runners_data.note: Saffie Osborne's mount carries a tongue-piece and has a striking course record — two wins from five Goodwood starts over exactly this trip; from OR 92 she has scope if the good ground and 6f combination clicks again, and her recent course win (6/6f/GOO) is directly relevant.

runners_data.name: Beaujolais Nouveau
runners_data.note: A hold-up operator with genuine Goodwood course form including a 6f win here; Andrew Mullen drops in and the horse's natural style is suited to a steady-pace race where late runners get a chance — the 21-day freshener is not a concern given the horse's pattern.

runners_data.name: Fleetwater
runners_data.note: A true prominent racer who won over this course and distance but cannot secure that position today given the overcrowding — JS Moore's runner will be shuffled into unfamiliar mid-division territory, which materially weakens her chance despite the course-winning form.

runners_data.name: Machadadorp
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's lightly-raced 3yo has won twice at Goodwood over 7f and steps down to 6f — the slight drop in trip on her favourite track suits, and Oisin Murphy's experience in a big field is a major asset; the 4/4 Goodwood record is compelling.

runners_data.name: Sing The Blues
runners_data.note: Won over this course and distance at the last attempt (1/6f/GOO) and Cieren Fallon rides — compact form, consistent, and on the upgrade; the horse's recent pulled-up run on the going report is noted but prior form shows she handles good ground.

runners_data.name: Ruby's Angel
runners_data.note: David Probert's Hugo Palmer-trained 3yo has placed twice over 6f at Goodwood and won the trip in similar ground; her form is solid without being spectacular, and from OR 85 she is realistically rated in a race where top-rated horses will dominate the prominent positions.

runners_data.name: Angel Shared
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up filly who is often grinding into placings at Goodwood (placed 4th and 3rd from five starts here); Clifford Lee rides for Steph Hollinshead whose 14-day strike rate (0/8) is modest, and a finish position is more realistic than a win from OR 79.

runners_data.name: Shallow
runners_data.note: Consistent placer (three 2nds and two 3rds in last five) wearing a visor and handled by George Wood; the hold-up style is genuine and she has found Goodwood to her liking — in a falsely-run race she could outfinish many, but she is a habitual runner-up.

runners_data.name: Secret History
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's progressive 3yo has won three of five including over course and distance, but her natural prominent style cannot be deployed here — she is a horse displaced by the overcrowded prominent positions, and Ashley Lewis (5) is asked to navigate a large field in an unfamiliar mid-race role.

runners_data.name: Zighy
runners_data.note: Boughey's 3yo has two wins on Fibresand at Stayford and one at 6f, but her Goodwood form on good ground (2nd, 3rd, 4th) does not include a win; her prominent style is compressed into midfield here, and from OR 82 the handicapper has her on a realistic mark if she finds a clear run.

runners_data.name: Rogue Attraction
runners_data.note: Harry Davies rides for Edward Bethell, and the horse has two wins at Goodwood over 6f on good ground; the hold-up style is authentic and the form justifies respect — the question is whether a 21-runner field allows a clean passage from the back.

runners_data.name: Zen Diva
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's 3yo has won twice at Goodwood over 6f (the last two runs) and Silvestre De Sousa takes the ride; the true style is prominent but the overcrowded field pushes her into midfield — despite the redistribution, her recent course-winning sequence gives her genuine claims if she can find clear air.

runners_data.name: Paradise Walk
runners_data.note: Beckett's second runner, having run just four days ago; her wins have come over 5f and 6f at Goodwood but the quick turnaround after a recent outing is a stamina/freshness question, and she is another displaced prominent racer forced to find a way through from further back than ideal.

runners_data.name: Bintaryana
runners_data.note: William Knight's 3yo has won twice over this course and trip; Luke Morris takes the ride and the going is fine, but 46 days off is a mild query, and her natural position at the front of affairs is not available to her — she must be delivered from further back than she has managed when winning.

runners_data.name: Diamont Katie
runners_data.note: KR Burke's 4yo has a strong Goodwood course record (one win, four places) over 6f and 7f; Jack Nicholls (3) is the pilot and the horse is a natural prominent racer finding herself in unfamiliar mid-pack territory — her consistency makes her a live each-way runner from OR 74.

runners_data.name: Polka Blue
runners_data.note: Charles Hills' 3yo is consistent (three 3rds in last six) and has won over course and trip; Kieran O'Neill rides and the horse's record (4/10 in similar going) is moderate, but she has placed at Goodwood before and her prominent instincts — if she can find a lane — make her dangerous in a result-producing scenario.

runners_data.name: Woohoo
runners_data.note: Jim Goldie's 5yo mare is prolific in placing (multiple 2nds on recent form, notably five 2nds in last six at 5f) but those runs have mostly been over 5f — stepping up to 6f with Lauren Young (5) in a 21-runner field is a tough assignment, and her natural desire to race prominently cannot be met today.

races.paceDynamic: Cinque Verde is the one confirmed front-runner in a field of 21, and on good ground over Goodwood's straight six, she will set a controlled, sustainable gallop rather than a scorching pace — there is simply no pressure horse to force her hand. Behind her, the prominent positions are severely oversubscribed: Hold A Dream, Stormy Impact, Cindy Lou Who, Gold Digger, Machadadorp, Sing The Blues and Ruby's Angel all want to race close to the pace, meaning the early battle for position will be fierce and several natural front-runners will be shuffled wider or further back than they prefer. The field holds materially more prominent-racing types than the map can accommodate, with Fleetwater, Secret History, Zighy, Zen Diva, Paradise Walk, Bintaryana, Diamont Katie, Polka Blue and Woohoo all genuine front-movers who will be unable to secure their natural berth and will be forced to race in an uncharacteristic midfield position. With a single, uncontested pace-setter creating a steady tempo, horses who can sit in a prime stalking position three to five lengths off the leader — and possess a reliable, measured turn of foot — are most advantaged; Cinque Verde leads but does not dominate, meaning the race is likely to be won by a quality prominent racer who tracks her smoothly and picks off the leader inside the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cinque Verde Leads, Stalkers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Cinque Verde dictates a controlled pace and a true prominent racer settles just off her in a clean position, that horse produces a sustained run to collar her in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Cinque Verde's uncontested lead is generous to horses settled two to four lengths behind, and those who secure a clean prominent pitch without being crowded out will have first run on the field; the good ground rewards horses with a sustained stride rather than a sudden burst.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Hold-Ups Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If Cinque Verde sets an even gentler tempo than expected and the jostling for prominent positions causes mid-race compression, hold-up horses get a clear passage late.
scenarios.body: Beaujolais Nouveau, Angel Shared and Shallow will be hunting their ground from the final two furlongs and a falsely-run race that compresses into a sprint finish suits those with natural acceleration off a slow pace; Shallow's consistent placing form at Goodwood makes her dangerous in this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Crowd Creates Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the battle for prominent positions causes interference and a degree of pace pressure from the second rank, the race is run at an honest clip that rewards those tracking wide with a clean run.
scenarios.body: The scramble among the many natural front-runners for the limited space behind Cinque Verde may push some wide into clean air, where a horse like Gold Digger or Zighy — despite redistribution — finds the right rhythm; this shape tilts toward horses with the class to handle an unsettled early experience and still fire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsiders Exploit Mayhem
scenarios.trigger: If the large, congested field creates significant traffic problems in mid-race and the race fragments into small groups at different paces, lower-rated horses with strong Goodwood form find winning positions.
scenarios.body: A messy race in a 21-runner sprint can produce a shock winner when fancied horses are repeatedly baulked or boxed in; horses like Diamont Katie or Polka Blue, both with positive Goodwood course records, could slide through a gap that more-fancied rivals cannot find.

watchPoints.text: Watch the battle for the prominent positions behind Cinque Verde in the first two furlongs — with Hold A Dream, Gold Digger, Machadadorp, Stormy Impact and Sing The Blues all wanting to be close to the pace in a 21-runner field, early crowding and interference could compromise several fancied runners before the race begins in earnest.

Machadadorp's step down from 7f to 6f at Goodwood with Oisin Murphy is a major tactical watch — if Murphy can slot her cleanly into second or third position without being shuffled back in the early rush, she is a serious threat to the result.

Gold Digger's tongue-tie (tp) and two Goodwood wins over this exact course and trip make her dangerous, but watch whether Saffie Osborne can secure a clean prominent berth given the overcrowding — if she is bumped wide or back early, her chance is compromised.
